chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality 375: The Yasha King Emerges
chapter_meta_description: Wu Zhanhun defeats the Holy Dragon King with Return to the Origin, but the dreaded Yasha King arrives. Forbidden weapons are deployed, yet the allies face ruin.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 375 – The Yasha King Emerges
og_description: A devastating battle of ultimate techniques ends in victory, but the invincible Yasha King appears, forcing the use of forbidden relics from a lost civilization.
